meta.title: teeTIM // natural fiber ... artificial design
meta.desc: Home page of the clothing designer 100% made in Quebec, designed by TIM students using designs produced by artificial intelligence, and made with 100% natural and organic fibers.

accueil.amorceH1: T-shirts, hoodies, and caps made in Quebec 💯
accueil.amorceH4: /** with a little bit of help from DALL-E 😉 **/
accueil.para1: Today, the t-shirt is an essential garment in everyone's wardrobe. And at a time when environmental issues are more pressing than ever, we prefer t-shirts made in Quebec to reduce environmental impact and highlight local craftsmanship.
accueil.para2: V-neck, crew neck, loose or fitted, short-sleeved or long-sleeved for those who get cold easily, plain or patterned to style an outfit… The t-shirt is available in a variety of colors, styles, and patterns.
